I usually stay up through the whole thing and I concentrate on it, but after it ends I find my mind is usually a bit clearer and I'm able to get to sleep easier.

I also find that if I can concentrate on something instead of letting my mind wander around horror stories, it is easier to sleep. Here are some sound sites that you could play on your phone or computer as a background noise. They might help:

  • http://listen.hatnote.com/
  • http://rain.simplynoise.com/
  • http://www.rainymood.com/

I listed both rainymood and rain@simplynoise because you might prefer one over the other. In rainymood sometimes I hear what sounds like sirens in the background and it puts me off, so I prefer the one at simplynoise.

He's referring to an old game show. At the end of the show the contestant would have three doors to choose from, behind two were goats and behind the other was a car.

The contestant would pick a door, then the host reveals the goat behind one of the other doors. The contestant can then either swap to the third door or stay with their first pick.

The interesting effect is that they are twice as likely to be right, and get the car, if they swapped there choice.

In simple terms;

The door they picked has a 1/3 chance of being the car.

The doors they didn't pick have 2/3 chance of being the car.

With one of the other two revealed this doesn't change the odds. So the door they picked still has a 1/3 chance of being a car and the remaining door has a 2/3 chance of being the car.

It's counter-intuitive as people assume that the options are down to a pick of two doors so it should be 1/2 chance each.

There's a full wiki page on it here. The maths is interesting.
